I'm a solo dev in Abidjan. On October 13 I launched Upstar, a site that ranks the GitHub repos taking off inside each topic: self-hosted, Rust, local LLMs, Android, agent skills, 69 topics so far.
The idea is simple. GitHub Trending is one big list where the same giants win every day. On Upstar, every topic is its own little league, and growth is weighed against size. So a 300-star project that doubles in a week can beat a giant that gains 2,000.
I built it with Claude Code. That detail matters later.
Google picked it up faster than I expected. 14 clicks on the first full day, 51 the next, 159 on October 19. I refreshed Search Console way too often.
By October 22, Upstar was showing up about 6,450 times a day in Google, with 147 clicks. About 20 people had signed up for the…
articles.title: My GitHub trending site lost 84% of its Google traffic in one day. Here's what I got wrong.

articles.author: Hanin Mp
articles.description:
PageSpeed Insights answers "does this one URL pass Core Web Vitals?" well. It answers badly when you have 300 URLs, a template you want to compare, or a weekly report to produce. The CrUX API is the source of that field data, and it is small enough to call from a short script with no dependencies.
The catch is that a few details of the response are easy to get wrong, and one of them silently changes what your report means. This post walks through a standard-library Python script and the traps it handles.
The CrUX API returns real-user data from Chrome, aggregated over a rolling 28-day window and refreshed daily. For each metric you get a histogram and a 75th percentile (p75). You can ask for a single url or for the whole origin, and optionally for one formFactor (PHONE, DESKTOP or TABLET).…
articles.title: Does this URL pass Core Web Vitals? Check CrUX field data in Python, with an honest origin fallback

articles.author: Odumosu Matthew
articles.description:
𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐢𝐚 𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐝. 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐓𝐨𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐨.
Both find the same small hotel in Lisbon for the same weekend. Both see “Only 1 room left!”
At exactly the same second, both tap “Book now.”
Who gets the room?
In a badly built system, both do. Two confirmations. One room. One very awkward morning at the front desk.
Engineers call this a race condition: two operations each make a decision on information that’s about to become wrong.
Exactly the same scenario plays out in  payments, just with money instead of rooms. Two withdrawals, one balance, same moment.
Which of the five fixes have you used in production?
articles.title: RACE CONDITION

articles.author: FreyaLi
articles.description:
The EU AI Act Just Started Biting: Transparency Rules Are Live and GPAI Penalty Procedures Are Locked In

What Is Now In Force
The New Penalty Machinery
Why This Is Depressing
Why It Is Also Quietly Exciting
What Companies Must Do Now
The practical sequence is unglamorous but urgent. Inventory every AI system in use, classify each by risk tier, draft or update an AI usage policy, and train staff on literacy obligations. For anything touching high-risk Annex III uses — recruitment, credit scoring, certain judicial applications — the deferred deadline of 2 December 2027 is the one to watch, but the scaffolding must be built now. Deployers leaning on third-party vendor models should demand declarations of conformity and training-data summaries in their contracts, because under the Act those obligations flow straight through the supply chain. The era of "move fast and ask forgiveness from no one" is, at least in Europe, over.
articles.title: The EU AI Act Just Started Biting

GRC platforms catch violations after the fact. Where ISO 42001, AARM, and Agentic Trust Controls sit in the stack, and how to close the three evidence gaps that block an audit.

Dalam mengamati perkembangan infrastruktur Web3, kita sering melihat inovasi kriptografi hanya beroperasi di lapisan protokol (L1/L2). Cakranex (CKAX) mengambil pendekatan berbeda dengan mengimplementasikan tumpukan kriptografi ini langsung ke dalam mesin eksekusi bursa tingkat institusi di pasar Asia-Pasifik. Laporan ini membedah spesifikasi teknis di balik arsitektur mereka.

Verifikasi Solvabilitas dengan ZK-Rollup
Solusi Cakranex: Mengganti audit statis kuartalan dengan atestasi kriptografis berkelanjutan (continuous cryptographic attestation) yang dijangkar ke L1 publik.
Mekanisme / Stack:
Smart Contract Wallet via EIP-4337 (Account Abstraction)
Solusi Cakranex: Memisahkan lapisan otorisasi (siapa yang bisa menandatangani) dari lapisan identitas menggunakan model Smart Contract Wallet.
Mekanisme / Stack:
Ketahanan Sybil Berbasis Grafik (Graph Anomaly Detection)
Solusi Cakranex: Menjadikan ketahanan Sybil (Sybil resistance) sebagai subsistem kelas satu, dirancang secara proaktif untuk menjaga integritas dan keseimbangan distribusi aset.
Mekanisme / Stack:
Penafian: Laporan independen ini bukan saran keuangan. Aset digital berisiko tinggi. Selalu lakukan riset mandiri (DYOR).
articles.title: Arsitektur di Balik Cakranex (CKAX): Membawa ZK-Rollup & EIP-4337 ke Bursa Ritel
